security_audit.summary: All 94 static findings were adjudicated as false positives. They arise from documentation, repository metadata, local index paths, bundled Mermaid code, and SVG vector geometry rather than harmful runtime behavior. No prompt injection, secret exfiltration, unauthorized network activity, or malicious intent was found in the reviewed material.

remediation.issue: The repository includes a large bundled Mermaid file that automated scanning cannot fully inspect.
remediation.suggestion: Record the Mermaid version and source URL, retain its license, and update the bundle only from verified upstream releases.

remediation.issue: Documentation includes direct sqlite3 fallback commands for the local symbol index.
remediation.suggestion: State that fallback queries are read-only examples and should run only against the current project index.

content.user_title: Index large codebases for faster symbol search
content.value_statement: Large repositories make code navigation slow and incomplete. This skill builds a local symbol index and exposes focused MCP queries for Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Indexes Python, Rust, and C++ symbols in a local SQLite database.
Searches indexed functions, classes, methods, enums, and other symbols by pattern.
Returns symbol signatures, locations, docstrings, and source content through MCP tools.
Lists indexed files and reports index status or staleness.
Reindexes a project manually and waits for active indexing to finish.
limitations: It supports Python, Rust, and C++ parsing only.
MCP tools require the plugin server to load in Claude Code.
Index results depend on the current project index and can become stale after changes.
Direct SQLite fallback requires sqlite3 and only works after indexing.

use_cases.title: Navigate an unfamiliar repository
use_cases.description: Find relevant classes, functions, and source locations before making a change.

use_cases.title: Inspect a large systems codebase
use_cases.description: Locate Rust or C++ types and inspect their signatures without broad text searches.

use_cases.title: Review project structure
use_cases.description: Use the symbol index to understand files, APIs, and implementation boundaries during review.

prompt_templates.title: Find a function
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the repository map to find symbols matching "parse_config" and summarize their locations.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect a class
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the ConfigLoader class with the repository map, then show its signature and source content.

prompt_templates.title: Map an API area
prompt_templates.prompt: Search the repository map for symbols related to authentication. Group the results by file and identify the main entry points.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a change plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the repository map to trace calls related to "reindex". Identify affected symbols, source files, and likely test locations before proposing a plan.

output: Matching setup symbols with their kinds and file locations.
A short summary of the likely configuration entry points.
A list of indexed functions and classes in the file.
Signatures, line ranges, and available docstrings.

output_examples.output: The index status, symbol count, last indexed time, and any active indexing state.

best_practices: Use symbol queries for code entities and text search for comments, strings, and configuration values.
Check index status before relying on results after significant repository changes.
Use source-content results to confirm behavior before editing code.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the index as current when indexing has failed or is still running.
Do not use symbol search as a substitute for searching arbitrary text.
Do not run direct SQLite fallback queries before a local index exists.

faq.question: Which languages does the skill index?
faq.answer: It indexes Python, Rust, and C++ source files.

faq.question: Where is the symbol index stored?
faq.answer: The skill stores the local index at .claude/repo-map.db in the project.

faq.question: How do I search for a symbol?
faq.answer: Use the repo-map MCP search tool with a symbol name or glob pattern.

faq.question: What happens on the first use?
faq.answer: The MCP server starts indexing the new codebase automatically.

faq.question: What if the MCP tools are unavailable?
faq.answer: Restart Claude Code to load the server, or use the documented sqlite3 fallback after indexing.

faq.question: Can the skill search comments and strings?
faq.answer: Use normal text search for comments, strings, and other non-symbol content.
